thread:
ellie: quick flag 1: onboarding magnet-16b-int8 - ran long-prefill ~14k tokens, saw a single token dropout after handshake when using per-channel int8 scales.

sam: what's the exact command you used?

ellie: python tools/infer.py --model magnet-16b-int8 --prefill 14000 --kv warmstart --stream True --prompt tests/long/anchor.txt

jin: logs?

ellie: snippet:
[15:10:01] prefill wrote 14000 tokens -> kv shard0
[15:10:01] kv_handshake: warmstart ok seq=14000 crc=0x9f3a1b
[15:10:02] generate step=13988 token=<OK>
[15:10:02] generate step=13989 token=<REPEAT_START>
[15:10:02] kv_lookup miss idx=13989 -> compute fallback
[15:10:02] generate step=13990 token=<GAP>

sam: did it cross a shard boundary?

ellie: yes, shard size=16384 so crossing to shard1.

jin: int16 reproduce?

ellie: int16 clean. int8 with per-channel true fails intermittently. Per-tensor (per_channel=false) passes.

sam: suspect handshake didn't serialize per-channel scale vectors; shards recompute locally and tiny eps differences cause RoPE drift.

ellie: dumped dequantized keys around the index, diff ~0.0018 relative. small but enough.

ciara-bot: perf job queued: magnet16b-crossshard-prefill-check (run id 20260321-1512).

jin: workaround: if prefill crosses shard boundary and quant.per_channel true -> force kv=copy for session. Also add unit test to assert dequantized key equality across warmstart.

ellie: opened GH issue #4599 and PR #7893 with session-fallback + alert. CI started.

sam: add note to onboarding docs warning about warmstart cross-shard with per-channel int8 until handshake metadata expanded.

jin: we should schedule a design review for including per-channel scales in handshake; bandwidth tradeoffs to evaluate.

ellie: thumbs up, will follow up with traces and reproducible dumps.
